meta.title: OpenRouter Plus
meta.description: Routing presets for OpenRouter and any OpenAI-compatible API. Runs a loopback relay that applies a preset to each Session at request time — fastest, cheapest, flex, priority, ultra or floor — plus an optional precision floor that keeps low-precision endpoints out of the pool, both chosen in the composer or set as the profile default for new Sessions, with live telemetry. No patching of shipped packages.
